capabilities.notes: The 15m and 30m caches are sufficient for a strict local diagnostic, but Alpaca Basic is IEX-only and no consolidated-data or official-print parity has been measured.
The registry and packet schema exist, but no real historical PIT packets are present and live collection requires a user-supplied compliant SEC_USER_AGENT.
The provider is trial status, credentials are not configured, and watchlist coverage, first-seen latency, rights, and deduplication have not been measured.
GDELT is forward metadata discovery only; the 2026-07-18 live probe returned HTTP 429 with zero records, and ticker/entity precision, duplicates, rights, and latency remain unqualified.
No licensed transcript or audio provider is registered, so call factors are outside the counted R5 candidates.

sample_data_caveats: Capability fixtures passed registry hygiene but were not used as strategy evidence.
The actual OHLCV inputs are research replay caches and not paper-ready evidence.
No event fixture, retrospective text extraction, or cache fallback was treated as PIT history.
